intro: 12 個貨運情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: To gauge these figures accurately, we first need to get some facts from the shipping department.
ex.zh: 要準確評估這些數字,我們首先需要從出貨部門取得一些事實資料。

ex.en: The container company must balance the load accurately or there could be a disaster at sea.
ex.zh: 貨櫃公司必須準確平衡載重,否則海上可能發生災難。

note: accurate 準確的;accuracy 準確度;inaccurate 不準確的

ex.en: Lou, our favorite carrier, takes extra care of our boxes marked "fragile."
ex.zh: 我們最愛的運送員盧,對標示「易碎」的箱子格外小心。

ex.en: Mr. Lau switched carriers in order to get a price savings on deliveries out of state.
ex.zh: 劉先生換了貨運公司,好省下寄往外州貨件的運費。

note: air carrier 航空公司;mail carrier 郵差

ex.en: The fall catalog shows a number of items that Mr. Lau has never before been able to offer.
ex.zh: 秋季目錄中有幾項是劉先生以前從未能提供的商品。

ex.en: Ellen cataloged the complaints according to severity.
ex.zh: 艾倫依照嚴重程度將客訴歸類整理。

note: 名詞動詞同形;動詞變化 cataloged

ex.en: All orders are fulfilled and ready for shipment within twenty-four hours.
ex.zh: 所有訂單都會在二十四小時內完成處理並準備出貨。

ex.en: Her expectations were so high, we knew they would be hard to fulfill.
ex.zh: 她的期望太高,我們知道會很難達到。

note: 美式 fulfill;英式 fulfil;過去式 fulfilled
fulfill an order / a requirement / a promise 履行訂單、要求、承諾

ex.en: Good customer relations are an integral component of any business.
ex.zh: 良好的客戶關係是任何企業不可或缺的組成部分。

ex.en: A dependable stream of inventory is integral to reliable shipping of orders.
ex.zh: 穩定的存貨供應流對訂單的可靠出貨是不可或缺的。

note: be integral to sth 是⋯不可缺的

ex.en: The store closes one day a year so that the staff can take inventory of the stockroom.
ex.zh: 這家店一年停業一天,讓員工能盤點庫房的存貨。

ex.en: Their inventory has not changed much over the years.
ex.zh: 多年來他們的存貨並沒有太大變化。

note: take inventory 盤點;in inventory 有庫存

ex.en: The shipping staff minimized complaints by working overtime to deliver the packages quickly.
ex.zh: 出貨人員加班迅速送出包裹,把客訴降到最低。

ex.en: To keep customers happy and minimize the effect of the strike, we shipped orders directly to them.
ex.zh: 為了讓客戶滿意並把罷工的影響降到最低,我們直接把訂單寄給他們。

note: minimum 最小值;minimal 最小的

ex.en: We had too much stock on hand, so we had a summer sale.
ex.zh: 我們手邊庫存太多,所以辦了夏季大特賣。

ex.en: The new employee will be on hand if we need more help with shipping orders.
ex.zh: 如果出貨作業需要更多人手,這位新員工會隨時待命。

note: on hand 是手邊有;on the other hand 是「另一方面」

ex.en: You will receive your order within one week of the shipping date.
ex.zh: 你會在出貨日起一週內收到訂單。

ex.en: When we received the package, the box was broken and some of the contents were missing.
ex.zh: 我們收到包裹時,箱子已經破了,部分內容物不見了。

note: i 在 e 之前,但 c 之後相反:receive
receipt 收據;recipient 收件人;reception 接待

ex.en: We shipped the package yesterday, so it should arrive by the end of the week.
ex.zh: 我們昨天寄出了包裹,所以應該會在本週末前送達。

ex.en: Very few customers think about how their packages will be shipped, and are seldom home when the packages arrive.
ex.zh: 很少有顧客會去想自己的包裹是怎麼運送的,而且包裹送達時他們很少在家。

ex.en: Customers aren't choosing express shipping because it hasn't been sufficiently advertised.
ex.zh: 顧客沒有選擇快遞運送,是因為宣傳得不夠充分。

ex.en: We are sufficiently organized to begin transferring the palettes tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們已有充分的安排,明天就能開始搬運貨板。

note: sufficient 足夠的;suffice 足夠;insufficient 不足的

ex.en: By making better use of our supplies, we can avoid ordering until next month.
ex.zh: 只要更善用我們的備品,就能避免在下個月之前訂貨。

ex.en: Gerald supplied the shipping staff with enough labels to last a year.
ex.zh: 傑拉德供給出貨人員足夠使用一年的標籤。

note: supply and demand 供需;in short supply 供應短缺
supply sb with sth 供應某人某物
